bugs.description: Command.get_short_help_str passes limit - 1 as max_length to _make_default_short_help in utils.py, so the short help derived from the help text is truncated one character earlier than the requested limit.
File.convert registers f.close directly instead of wrapping it in _safecall, so an error raised while closing the file propagates out of the context teardown instead of being swallowed.
